mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_info (user_id, category_id, title, description, images, original_price, price, is_exchange, exchange_desc, status, view_count, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{images}, #{originalPrice}, #{price}, #{isExchange}, #{exchangeDesc}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{createTime})

where.if: AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS publisherName, u.avatar AS publisherAvatar, c.name AS categoryName FROM goods_info g LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.category_id
ORDER BY
g.price ASC, g.create_time DESC g.view_count DESC, g.create_time DESC g.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods_info WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods_info WHERE status = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS newGoods FROM goods_info WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS publisherName, u.avatar AS publisherAvatar, c.name AS categoryName FROM goods_info g LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.category_id WHERE g.goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.update: UPDATE goods_info SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}
